finding_results.reason: Active package and unique tracker resolution remain package-neutral, live-main bound and fail-closed; the historical audit baseline is explicitly non-authoritative.
Designated live projections remain governance-guarded and canonical product state is still PKG-03 10/25 with cursor 03.11; remediation did not mutate tracker/master product state.
The checkpoint now exposes first-class last_verified_action, blockers and gates records, while remaining explicitly non-authoritative and requiring live refresh before mutation/resume.
The approved canonical adoption state IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED is exact; IMPLEMENTED_BUT_NOT_VERIFIED is retained only as an explicit legacy alias.
All six approved project states and evidence-backed AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN capability states remain first-class and fail closed on unknown capability.
Canonical acceptance and WIP/checkpoint state remain explicitly distinct; open branches/PRs cannot promote tracker completion.
Historical blueprint content remains labeled as non-live historical baseline and points execution to live canonical authorities.
Exact CORRECTION/COMPLETION/HARDENING/OPTIMIZATION/NEW_PRODUCT_SCOPE classification is machine-readable; NEW_PRODUCT_SCOPE is non-auto and requires explicit approval.
Exact TASK/MODULE/MILESTONE/PHASE/PROJECT approval scope is represented with monotonic inherited authority, reapproval triggers and no retroactive reapproval of clearly authorized existing work.

Deep module/option contracts cover identity, interfaces and UI states, responsive/accessibility, permissions, data, workflows, integrations, security, failure handling, observability, performance, testing, migration, rollback and acceptance, with non-applicable rationale semantics.
must, must_not, abuse_cases and forbidden_boundaries remain first-class, and negative requirements are acceptance obligations.
Expected changes, shared surfaces, scope budgets and STOP_AND_REASSESS behavior remain explicit and machine-readable.

Exact PARALLEL_SAFE/COORDINATED_PARALLEL/SERIALIZE/BLOCKED classes are represented with shared surfaces, collision keys, coordination/serialization data and package concurrency authority; branch separation alone is not treated as safety.
FAST GATE and FULL GATE remain distinct, and fast evidence cannot substitute for required pre-merge/final acceptance evidence.
BASELINE_FAILURE requires exact canonical-base reproduction; retry-until-green is not acceptance and flaky-test handling remains evidence/owner/expiry bound.

Universal DoD now explicitly covers implementation/intent, acceptance/tests, security, safe errors, data integrity/migration, performance where applicable, integration, docs/checkpoint, coherent VCS/history, known limitations/not-verified items and rollback/recovery/cleanup; PARTIALLY_COMPLETE cannot be claimed as complete.
Exact SELF_REVIEW/INDEPENDENT_AI_REVIEW/HUMAN_REVIEW/REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_REVIEW provenance exists; self review cannot satisfy independent/external review and automation evidence is recorded separately.

Operational readiness still requires structured/audit logs, correlation/request IDs, health, metrics, alerts, job monitoring, troubleshooting/runbook treatment and sensitive-log redaction or explicit not-applicable rationale.
BUILT/DEPLOYED/RELEASED/PRODUCTION_VERIFIED and recovery classes remain distinct and evidence-bound; IRREVERSIBLE action requires exact explicit approval.
Incident governance preserves Stabilize -> Contain -> Preserve Evidence -> Diagnose -> Recover -> Verify -> Root Cause -> Prevent Recurrence and prevents broad feature refactoring during containment.
Stop-the-line triggers and stopped-state semantics remain explicit; normal feature mutation is blocked on affected surfaces until recovery governance permits it.
Durable handoff/end-task reporting remains sufficient for chat-independent resume, and unrelated findings remain separately queued unless scope/change control authorizes mutation.
